glosses: to chime in (to agree, to harmonize, to concord)
wyrazić aprobatę / zgodę z kimś lub czymś

examples.text: Czyli te wakacje to prawda! – dopytywała Marta Manowska, a rolnik przytaknął.

glosses: To talk; to join in conversation or discussion.

examples.text: We appreciate your input, so please don't hesitate to chime in with comments and questions.

Atherton chimed in.
‘To that I say, Amen!’ He lifted his hand. ‘God is my witness!’

glosses: To agree, to harmonize, to concord.

examples.text: I was therefore obliged to chime in with her plan, which in truth seemed well arranged: […]

What I saw upon this cliff, although surely an object of very extraordinary nature, the place and season considered, at first neither startled nor amazed me—so thoroughly and appropriately did it chime in with the half-slumberous fancies that enwrapped me.
